arguments.Title: Depart Hitech using planned turnaround
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using System.IO; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var c=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(); if(c==null||c.Status!="목적 거점 도착"){result.Log("NOT_ARRIVED status="+c?.Status);return;} File.WriteAllText("artifacts/high_speed_drive/turn-depart-observation.json",c.LatestObservationJson); c.StartMission("library_road_candidate"); result.Log("Library departure requested from measured Hitech arrival"); } }
